prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept.
Asset type: production mobile base-building game terrain BACKGROUND ONLY, portrait approximately 1024x1792.
Input 1 is the terrain to redesign. Input 2 is ONLY a style/material reference for independent building sprites that will be overlaid later. Do NOT draw that factory or any other buildings into the terrain.
Primary request: remove the rigid straight tiled crossroad and giant rectangular courtyard. Redesign as a believable organically developed survivor settlement, with winding dirt access tracks, irregular patches of meadow, broken stone paving, small landscaping pockets and distinct functional ground treatments. Match the rounded polished toy-like cartoon rendering, soft sage foliage, warm cream stone, muted sandy ground, overhead orthographic 3/4 camera and soft upper-left daylight of the references.
Layout is constrained by existing game building overlays: coordinates below are percentages from the TOP LEFT; each coordinate marks the ground/front entrance anchor, NOT building center. Keep the terrain beneath the building footprints unobstructed; empty clearings should NOT have drawn rectangular outlines or plot numbers. Building sprites will cover ground ABOVE their anchors.
1 Headquarters entrance (29,23), footprint x8..49 y7..23. Irregular worn flagstone forecourt immediately BELOW y23, small sage planted edge, short curving path.
2 Power station (80,21), footprint x66..94 y10..21. Subtle sandy utility clearing and a small cable conduit beside the outer wall, not across footprint.
3 Factory entrance (81,42), footprint x64..97 y25..42. Dusty darker compacted industrial apron just below y42, curved wheel tracks leading toward center-lower logistics route, a few tiny barrels along far right boundary only.
4 Research entrance (16,56), footprint x3..29 y41..56. Quiet pale gravel clearing, small greener patch on outer left margin, discreet stepping stones.
5 Warehouse (47,65), footprint x33..61 y52..65. Open irregular packed earth loading space immediately below y65, sparse pallet and crate stack off to the side, ground accessible by a gently curving wide dirt route.
6 Recycling workshop (46,78), footprint x33..59 y65..78. Gravel and scuffed dust beneath footprint; small sorted scrap piles, timber and stones in side pockets around x25 y80 and x64 y81, clear entrance at x46 y78.
Additional future facilities occupy x15 y39, x44 y38, x46 y53, x82 y58, x17 y73, x82 y72. Leave these areas as low-detail open ground, no tall vegetation or props over them.
The bottom gate stays centered at (50,91), with an organically curved dirt road from the gate branching naturally toward workshop, factory and HQ. Paths should use asymmetrical Y branches and curved forks, NEVER a straight plus-sign intersection, city grid, long straight vertical centerline or straight horizontal strip. There must be NO rectangular roads or vast uniform beige field. Irregular low grass islands and pebble margins break up the ground between usable clearings. Keep lushest low foliage along perimeter, restrained green patches inside. Organic asymmetrical broken boundary walls and rocks frame the space, wider gaps and varied silhouettes, rather than a rigid boxed rectangle. Keep gate and outer perimeter in the same general locations.
Rendering priorities: wide quiet building footprint areas, ground remains subordinate to bright blue/gold/green buildings, modest peripheral detail, natural believable connections, soft chunky toy proportions, readable at phone size. No buildings, no roofs, no characters, no UI, no labels, no letters, no plot markers, no watermark. Full opaque terrain image, not a screenshot, no border.
